name: utthan-ngo
description: Public website for Utthan NGO — a content-driven Next.js, NestJS and Sanity monorepo.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend,studio -c cyan,magenta,green "npm -w utthan-frontend run dev" "npm -w utthan-backend run start:dev" "npm -w utthan-sanity run dev"
scripts.build: npm -w utthan-frontend run build && npm -w utthan-backend run build
scripts.lint: npm -w utthan-frontend run lint && npm -w utthan-backend run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm -w utthan-frontend run typecheck && npm -w utthan-backend run typecheck
scripts.typegen: npm -w utthan-sanity run typegen:extract && npm -w utthan-sanity run typegen:generate
